campaign_performance.name: Campaign Performance Analysis
campaign_performance.description: Comprehensive campaign performance metrics with JOINs and aggregations
campaign_performance.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.status,
                        c.channel,
                        c.budget,
                        c.start_date,
                        c.end_date,
                        COUNT(r.report_id) as total_reports,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.impressions), 0) as total_impressions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.clicks), 0) as total_clicks,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions), 0) as total_conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.CTR), 0), 4) as avg_ctr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.CVR), 0), 4) as avg_cvr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0) * 100, 0), 2) as conversion_rate
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.status, c.channel, c.budget, c.start_date, c.end_date
                    ORDER BY total_conversions DESC

status.description: Filter by campaign status (Active, Completed, Paused)

channel.description: Filter by marketing channel (Email, Social, Display, Search)

channel_breakdown.name: Channel Performance Breakdown
channel_breakdown.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.channel,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT c.campaign_id) as total_campaigns,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.impressions), 0) as total_impressions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.clicks), 0) as total_clicks,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions), 0) as total_conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.CTR), 0), 4) as avg_ctr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.CVR), 0), 4) as avg_cvr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.channel
                    ORDER BY total_conversions DESC

budget_analysis.name: Budget Utilization Analysis
budget_analysis.description: Budget spending analysis and utilization metrics
budget_analysis.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.budget,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) as actual_spend,
                        ROUND(COALESCE((SUM(r.cost) / c.budget) * 100, 0), 2) as budget_utilization_pct,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(c.budget - SUM(r.cost), c.budget), 2) as remaining_budget,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions), 0) as total_conversions,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.budget
                    ORDER BY budget_utilization_pct DESC

conversion_metrics.name: Conversion Metrics & KPIs
conversion_metrics.description: Detailed conversion analysis and key performance indicators
conversion_metrics.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.channel,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.impressions), 0) as total_impressions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.clicks), 0) as total_clicks,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions), 0) as total_conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(r.impressions), 0) * 100, 0), 2) as ctr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0) * 100, 0), 2) as cvr,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0), 0), 2) as cpc,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 0), 2) as cpa,
                        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.impressions), 0) * 100, 0), 2) as conversion_rate
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.channel
                    ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

trend_analysis.name: Performance Trend Analysis
trend_analysis.description: Time-series analysis of campaign performance trends
trend_analysis.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.start_date) as month,
                        c.channel,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT c.campaign_id) as campaigns_count,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.impressions), 0) as total_impressions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.clicks), 0) as total_clicks,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.conversions), 0) as total_conversions,
                        COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) as total_cost
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', c.start_date), c.channel
                    ORDER BY month DESC, total_conversions DESC
